recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the current publisher stops generating the Element UML tab or the Element StructureDefinition JSON/XML pages from the active Type Framework source.
issue_request: FHIR-5368 was a Published FHIR-core DSTU1 change request, resolved Persuasive, asking to add missing UML and JSON-template representations when following the Element link under Infrastructure Types.
initial_application: The Jira comments identify SVN revision 5522, which maps in git history to dbe4c724c1b44009c33b636b8131203870f0e958, '#5368: fix Element UML representation'. That commit changed the historical SVG generator so an Element-only diagram rendered Element's attributes and avoided child-class recursion; no separate Jira-keyed JSON-template source hunk was found.
additional_context: The old Infrastructure Types presentation has been refactored into the Type Framework. source/fhir.ini keeps Element as an active abstract infrastructure type and maps element to source/types.html. source/types.html has the Element section and generated structure/UML links, while source/datatypes/element.xml defines Element.id and Element.extension. Current build output at build.fhir.org shows types.html#Element with Structure, UML, Version Diff, and All tabs, and element.profile.json.html and element.profile.xml.html return HTTP 200. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current authoritative source already feeds the requested Element representation output, and adding local prose or hand-edited generated artifacts would duplicate current build behavior rather than correct the current specification.
